```{r}
###############################
# Wordcloud colors
###############################
pal = brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")
practice_wordcloud1 <- Corpus(VectorSource(dataset$column_name))
practice_wordcloud1
wordcloud(practice_wordcloud1, max.words = 500, random.order = FALSE, colors=pal)

##Adding cleaning conditions to wordcloud dataset
practice_wordcloud1 <- tm_map(practice_wordcloud1, removePunctuation)
practice_wordcloud2 <- tm_map(practice_wordcloud1, tolower)
practice_wordcloud3 <- tm_map(practice_wordcloud2, stripWhitespace)
practice_wordcloud4 <- tm_map(practice_wordcloud3, removeWords, c(stopwords('english')))
wordcloud(practice_wordcloud4, max.words=500, random.order=FALSE, colors=pal)

###############################
# Tidytext - Clean data
###############################
data_df <- data.frame(text=dataset$column_name)
data_df$text <- as.character(data_df$text)
#Encoding(data_df$text) <- "latin1" #//gsub error fix
data_df$text2 <- gsub('http\\S+\\s*', '', data_df$text)
data_df$text <- gsub('\\b+RT', '', data_df$text)
data_df$text <- gsub('#\\S+', '', data_df$text)
data_df$text <- gsub('@\\S+', '', data_df$text)
data_df$text <- gsub('[[:cntrl:]]', '', data_df$text)
data_df$text <- gsub('\\d', '', data_df$text)
tryToLower <- function(x){
  y=NA
  try_error=tryCatch(tolower(x), error=function(e)e)
  if(!inherits(try_error, 'error'))
    y=tolower(x)
  return(y)
}
custom_stopwords <- c(stopwords('english'))
clean_corpus <- function(corpus){
  corpus <- tm_map(corpus, content_transformer(tryToLower))
  corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removeWords, custom_stopwords)
  corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removePunctuation)
  corpus <- tm_map(corpus, stripWhitespace)
  return(corpus)
}
corpus <-Corpus(VectorSource(data_df$text))
corpus <- clean_corpus(corpus)
tdm <- TermDocumentMatrix(corpus)
tdm
m <- as.matrix(tdm)
m
###############################
# Tidytext - Create data set tweets_td
###############################

dtm <- DocumentTermMatrix(corpus)
str(dtm)
word_freq <- tidy(dtm)
word_freq

###############################
# Tidytext - Word frequency
###############################
word_freq %>%
  count(term, sort=T)%>%
  filter(n>=30)%>%
  mutate(word=reorder(term,n))%>%
  ggplot(aes(word, n))+
  geom_col(fill="yellow", col="black")+
  xlab(NULL)+
  coord_flip()+
  ggtitle("Word frequency >= 30")+
  theme(plot.title=element_text(size=10, face="bold"))+
  theme_bw()

###############################
# Sentiment analysis - Not Tidytext
###############################
sentiment_analysis_data<- as.character(dataset$column_name)
sentiment_analysis_data
nrc_lexicon <- get_sentiments("nrc")
nrc_lexicon
s_analysis<- get_nrc_sentiment(sentiment_analysis_data)
s_analysis
data_sentiment_score <- data.frame(colSums(s_analysis[,]))
data_sentiment_score
names(data_sentiment_score) <- "Score"
names(data_sentiment_score)
data_sentiment_score <- cbind("sentiment"=rownames(data_sentiment_score),
                              
                              data_sentiment_score)
rownames(data_sentiment_score) <- NULL
ggplot(data=data_sentiment_score, aes(x=sentiment, y=Score))+
  geom_bar(aes(fill=sentiment), stat="identity") +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  xlab("Sentiments")+
  ylab("Scores")+
  ggtitle("Title of Sentiment Analysis")
##Remove the positive and negative sentiment results
data_sentiment_score[,]

data_sentiment_score2 <- data_sentiment_score[1:8,]
ggplot(data=data_sentiment_score2, aes(x=sentiment, y=Score))+
  geom_bar(aes(fill=sentiment), stat="identity") +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  xlab("Sentiments")+
  ylab("Scores")+
  ggtitle("Title of Sentiment Analysis")
###############################
# Tidytext - Sentiment words per emotion
###############################
nrc_sentiments <- word_freq%>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("nrc"), by=c(term="word"))%>%
  count(term, sentiment)%>%
  group_by(sentiment)%>%
  slice_max(term, n=10)%>%
  arrange(desc(n))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  #top_n(10)%>%
  mutate(term=reorder(term, n))%>%
  ggplot(aes(term, y=n, fill=sentiment))+
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE)+
  facet_wrap(~sentiment, scales="free")+
  labs(x=NULL, y= "NRC Sentiments and Associated          Words")+
coord_flip()
nrc_sentiments
###############################
# Tidytext - Wordcloud
###############################
wordcloud_words <- word_freq%>%
count(term, sort = T)%>%
filter(n>=4)
wordcloud_words
wordcloud2(data=wordcloud_words, size=2)
```

convert to csv

```{r}
hobbit <- read_delim("data/hobbit.txt", delim = "\t")

write_csv(hobbit, "hobbit.csv")
```

```{r}
library(xml2)

lines <- readLines("data/hobbit.txt", warn = FALSE)

txt <- xml_text(read_html(paste(lines, collapse = "\n")))

text_lines <- strsplit(txt, "\n")[[1]]
text_lines <- trimws(text_lines)
text_lines <- text_lines[text_lines != ""]

dfh <- data.frame(line = seq_along(text_lines), text = text_lines)
write.csv(dfh, "Hobbit_Clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
Hobbit <- read_csv("Hobbit_Clean.csv")
```
